labels.explanation: Car market statistics; no Helixa supplier or material involved.
Alpine Filtration AG (S026) adds sterile filter capacity: positive news about a supplier, no threat to supply.
San Juan in Argentina, not San Juan, Puerto Rico (S025). No Helixa supplier in the affected area.
Named supplier S009 (Rhenvale) loses one day; deliveries at most two days late. Minor and short; approved alternate S010 and 40 days cover.
Polaris Film Studios is a US film company in Atlanta, not Polaris Films Sp. z o.o. (S019, Lodz).
Ring-road closure delays Sao Paulo deliveries up to three days: affects Aurum Gelatin Capsules (S036, Sao Paulo) without naming it. Minor and short; alternate S037 and 40 days cover.
Cultural event in Oslo; no supply impact for Nordic Lipids (S012) or anyone else.
Single-source S040 will stop cleanroom garments at end of 2027: supply risk that needs a new source, but slow-moving (over a year) and supply continues.
36-hour power cut in Bergamo affects Vitrum Medica (S016, Bergamo) without naming it. Short; alternate S015 and 35 days cover.
Lumina Glassworks (S015) adds vial output: positive supplier news, no risk.
Celsius Heating Systems is a UK boiler maker, not Celsius Bioprocess Systems (S025, San Juan).
Regulator stops all production at single-source, High-criticality S003 for at least six weeks; only 30 days of cover.
Lancaster in England, not Lancaster, USA (S017). The warehouse belongs to a local paint distributor.
Single-source platform S035 will be switched off in mid-2028: supply risk that needs a replacement plan, not an immediate stop.
Competitor product launch; commercial news with no effect on Helixa's suppliers.
Main Xi'an China-Europe rail line closed four days: affects Silkroute Rail Freight (S033, Xi'an) without naming it. About one week of delay; alternate S032.
Single-source, High-criticality S025 stops bag output and recalls lots; no deliveries for at least ten weeks, beyond its 40 days of cover.
Kaveri Spinning Mills is a cotton yarn maker in Tamil Nadu, not Kaveri Fine Chemicals (S002, Ahmedabad).
Named supplier S018 runs on one of two foil lines; some orders one week late. Minor; alternate S019.
All factories in Valencia closed for at least eight weeks: stops single-source S011 (Valencia) beyond its 35 days of cover.
Regulator stops all shipments from single-source, High-criticality S008 for 4-6 months, beyond its 90 days of cover.
Cyprin Analytical Services (S034) doubles testing capacity: positive supplier news.
Hyderabad in Pakistan, not Hyderabad, India (S001).
Every chemical and lab products plant in Darmstadt stopped for at least three months: stops single-source S028 (Darmstadt) beyond its 60 days of cover.
Reactor failure stops all production at single-source, High-criticality S012 for at least ten weeks; only 30 days of cover.
Explosion shuts single-source, High-criticality S017 (Lancaster, USA); no deliveries for at least three months, beyond 40 days of cover.
All Osaka factories closed for at least two months: stops single-source S020 (Osaka) beyond its 45 days of cover.
Single-source S024 plans a move in H2 2027 with a gap of several weeks and requalification: slow-moving supply risk.
Nordic Lipid Foods is a Danish margarine maker, not Nordic Lipids AS (S012, Oslo).
Named supplier S029 delays some kits by up to ten days; Low criticality and 30 days cover: minor.
